title: Bubble Tea, read like a tree

specimen.common: Bubble Tea, the Go TUI framework, cut at HEAD
specimen.note: An event-loop rewrite in August 2024 cuts the widest ring, after three years of thinning growth. The 2020 sprint lays down the wide early rings, and the trunk is flat: most growth is in the repository root, with a second lobe towards examples/.

events.title: Boba, then Bubble Tea
events.note: renamed twice; components move to bubbles

events.title: v2.0.0
events.note: six years after the first pass

epilogue: Eighty-two monthly rings. The pith is one person's first pass; the outer wood is a project with 178 authors and 109 tags. The figure counts only what git can prove: commits, lines and tags, with lockfiles and build output left out.
